articles.title: JWST Uncovers a Cosmic Fossil: The Most Metal-Poor Galaxy Ever Seen in the Early Universe
articles.summary: Peering 13 billion years into the past, the James Webb telescope found LAP1-B, a galaxy with a record-low oxygen level—just 1/240th of the sun's. This chemically primitive galaxy is a direct ancestor of the faint dwarf galaxies orbiting the Milky Way.

articles.title: The Crystal Ball Nebula: A Haunting Preview of Our Sun's Fiery Death
articles.summary: A stunning new image of the Crystal Ball Nebula reveals the fate of stars like our sun. Located 1,500 light-years away, this planetary nebula harbors a rare binary star system at its heart, offering a direct look at what will happen to our solar system in 5 billion years.

articles.title: Bronze Age Brain Surgery: 4,000-Year-Old Child's Skull Found in Uzbekistan Is Oldest in Central Asia
articles.summary: A 5-year-old's skull unearthed in Uzbekistan shows clear signs of trepanation, making it the earliest evidence of surgery in Central Asia. The 4,000-year-old find at the Djarkutan site raises puzzling questions about ancient medical knowledge and ritual practices.
